acs.text: For every slot, confirmed bookings never exceed that slot's capacity, including concurrent booking attempts.

operand.derived: capacity configured for the same slot

acs.text: An eligible Abhyasi's booking takes effect without preceptor approval.

expected_answer.baseline: eligible Abhyasi has no booking for an open visible slot
expected_answer.operand: Abhyasi has a booking for that slot without preceptor approval

acs.text: Every slot shown to an Abhyasi is open and visible to that Abhyasi.

expected_answer.operand: displayed slots have remaining capacity and are visible to the Abhyasi

acs.text: Every eligible open slot from each preceptor linked to the Abhyasi is available in the Abhyasi's slot view.

expected_answer.operand: eligible open slots from every linked preceptor appear in the Abhyasi's slot view

acs.text: An Abhyasi is not shown slots restricted to other Abhyasis or belonging to unlinked preceptors.

expected_answer.operand: a slot restricted to another Abhyasi or belonging to an unlinked preceptor in the Abhyasi's slot view

acs.text: Each displayed slot time is rendered in the viewing Abhyasi's own timezone.

expected_answer.operand: slot's UTC instant converted to the viewing Abhyasi's timezone

gaps.risk_rationale: No product URL or test account is specified; this affects execution, not the promised outcomes.

judgements.rationale: Capacity violations risk lost seats/data integrity; visibility across accounts risks unauthorized exposure (auth); timezone and booking affect all users (user-reach). No payments or stated change-frequency risk. The source gives no URL, seeded accounts, capacities for fixtures, or concurrency control mechanism; these are unresolved execution assumptions, not new business rules.
